name: oh-my-orchestrator
description: Multi-vendor orchestration harness. The main Claude Code session is the executor; vendor CLIs are role-scoped advisors that gather, investigate, and rebut.

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: Explicit entry point for multi-vendor campaigns on a tracked board. The execution layer -- composes omo and harness; not a domain lane.

plugins.name: omo
plugins.description: Role-scoped vendor orchestration. Claude is the default executor; delegation needs a reason (two failed attempts, context budget, adversarial verification).

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Enforcement layer for a campaign board - blocking SubagentStop checks, consecutive-block safety valve, claim locks, runnable completion criteria with commit-based rollback.
